description: Code quality, architecture, and performance refactor for BubbleBoost Chrome extension

userStories.title: Add strict TypeScript config
userStories.description: Enable strict mode, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes. Fix all resulting type errors.
userStories.done_criteria: tsconfig.json has strict settings, pnpm run type-check passes

userStories.title: Add ESLint with strict rules
userStories.description: Add ESLint with @typescript-eslint, react-hooks, import-order rules. Fix all lint errors.
userStories.done_criteria: pnpm run lint passes with zero warnings

userStories.title: Extract check registry pattern
userStories.description: Create CheckRegistry class that auto-discovers checks. Each check exports metadata (id, name, highlightable, benchmark). Remove manual wiring.
userStories.done_criteria: Adding a new check requires only creating the file, no index.ts changes

userStories.title: Create typed event system
userStories.description: Replace direct store mutations with typed events: AnalysisStarted, AnalysisComplete, IssueHighlighted, etc. Add event logging for debugging.
userStories.done_criteria: All state changes go through event dispatch, events are typed

userStories.title: Separate DOM queries from scoring logic
userStories.description: Checks should return raw data (counts, elements). Separate module handles severity thresholds and scoring. Makes thresholds configurable.
userStories.done_criteria: Checks return CheckResult, separate scorer applies thresholds

userStories.title: Add check result caching with invalidation
userStories.description: Cache check results by DOM hash. Only re-run checks when relevant DOM subtree changes. Track cache hit rate.
userStories.done_criteria: Repeated analysis on unchanged DOM uses cache, logs hit rate

userStories.title: Batch DOM reads with requestIdleCallback
userStories.description: Collect all DOM queries, batch execute during idle time. Avoid layout thrashing. Add performance marks.
userStories.done_criteria: Analysis doesn't block main thread, uses requestIdleCallback

userStories.title: Tree-shake unused code and lazy load panel
userStories.description: Analyze bundle, remove dead code. Lazy load IssuePanel only when opened. Target <50KB content script.
userStories.done_criteria: Content script bundle <50KB, panel loads on demand

userStories.title: Add unit tests for checks
userStories.description: Add vitest. Write unit tests for each check with mock DOM. Target 80% coverage on src/lib/checks.
userStories.done_criteria: pnpm run test passes, coverage >80% on checks

userStories.title: Add integration test for full analysis flow
userStories.description: Test that runs full analysis on mock Bubble page HTML, verifies score calculation and issue generation.
